scams.name: Playa del Carmen 5th Avenue Tourist-Menu Restaurant & Bill-Padding Scam
scams.description: Quinta Avenida (5th Avenue) is Playa del Carmen's main tourist artery — 2 km of restaurants, bars, and shops — and hosts a 2025 bill-padding ecosystem similar to Cancún Hotel Zone. r/cancun 'Attempted Scam at La Parilla Restaurant in downtown' (comments/1d6kjdi, 2024) is a CANONICAL named anchor documenting a specific restaurant. r/cancun 'Well what a scam' (comments/1i71g5b, 2025) is a 2025 named anchor. r/cancun 'Made it out of cancun and was only scammed twice' (comments/1ktk6i9, 2025) documents 2025 tourist-experience patterns. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) English-only 'tourist menu' at 2–3x Spanish-menu prices (fish tacos MX$180 vs MX$45 at non-tourist spots); (b) 'service charge 18%' pre-added PLUS tip line at bottom (double-tipping trap); (c) credit-card surcharge 10–15% announced only at bill time (legitimate 0–3% max); (d) 'seafood market price' verbal quotes running MX$1,500–$3,500 per lobster vs real MX$700–$1,200/kg × actual weight; (e) 'bill switcheroo' where itemised receipt differs from card-swipe total by MX$300–$1,000; (f) free-drink-tourist-trap on Calle 12 where 'complimentary tequila' comes with 'MX$400 cover charge' post-consumption; (g) USD-priced menus at 10–15% padded exchange. For older travellers: (1) eat 2–3 blocks OFF 5th Avenue — restaurants on Avenida 15 and Calle 2/4 north have Google 4.5+ authentic spots at 1/3 the price; (2) reputable choices: Chez Céline (bakery), Imprevist (street-food), La Malquerida Tulum (local Mexican), Catch Seafood (honest pricing); (3) ASK for 'menú local' or 'menú en español' on 5th Avenue — sometimes yields the local-price menu; (4) seafood: agree weight × price/kg IN WRITING before cooking; (5) INSPECT bill line-by-line — 'service 18%' means NO additional tip needed; (6) confirm credit-card surcharge 0–3% BEFORE ordering; refuse 10–15% charges; (7) avoid 'complimentary tequila' offers from Calle 12 promoters — cover charge likely; (8) for budget eats, visit the Mercado 28 in Downtown Playa (2 km south of 5th Ave) — authentic MX$80–$150 per meal.
scams.avoidance: Eat 2–3 blocks OFF 5th Avenue on Avenida 15 / Calle 2 or 4 north Reputable: Chez Céline, Imprevist, La Malquerida, Catch Seafood Ask for 'menú local' on 5th Avenue for lower-price menu Seafood: agree weight × price/kg IN WRITING before cooking Inspect bill; confirm card surcharge 0–3% before ordering
scams.location: Quinta Avenida (5th Avenue) pedestrian strip, Parque Fundadores waterfront, Playacar gated-beach dining, Calle 10 tourist-menu clusters

scams.name: Playa del Carmen Cozumel Ferry Overcharge & Fake-Ticket Reseller
scams.description: The Playa del Carmen–Cozumel ferry is the second-biggest tourist transit in Quintana Roo after Cancún–Isla Mujeres. r/cancun 'Ferry from Playa Del Carmen to Cozumel' (comments/13o1ccb) is the community baseline anchor. r/cozumel 'Scammer selling Ultramar tickets' (comments/1k1qedr, 2025) is a CANONICAL 2025 named anchor documenting a specific reseller scam. r/cozumel "Don't talk to ATA in the airport after you clear customs" (comments/1jjivm6, 2025) is a 2025 named anchor covering the broader Quintana Roo tout ecosystem. Legitimate fares: Ultramar adult round-trip MX$820 (~US$46); Winjet MX$680. Ferries every 60–90 min 6 AM–11 PM; 45-min crossing. Tickets buyable at terminal window with card or cash. The 2025 scams: (a) 'Ultramar' imposter touts near the ferry terminal entrance selling at 2x face value (r/cozumel comments/1k1qedr, 2025 is the canonical case); (b) WhatsApp-based 'discount ferry' resellers (tickets are fake or already-used); (c) hotel concierge 'ferry + snorkel bundle' at US$120 per person that really costs US$50 separately; (d) 'VIP express' upsell at pier MX$1,500 (no VIP option exists — Ultramar and Winjet are the only licensed operators); (e) 'private boat to Cozumel MX$8,000' from Playa beach — unlicensed, dangerous; (f) return-ferry 'booked up' upsell trick ('only MX$1,200 upgrade available') — return ferries run standard schedule, no booking needed; (g) ticket substitution where tout sells you one-way at round-trip price. For older travellers: (1) buy tickets ONLY at the official Ultramar or Winjet window at Muelle Fiscal terminal — NEVER from anyone approaching you; (2) pay with credit card (chargeback protection) OR cash, get printed QR ticket; (3) round-trip Ultramar MX$820 / Winjet MX$680 — no 'VIP', no 'express', no upgrade tier; (4) IGNORE every WhatsApp/hotel-concierge 'ferry bundle' offer; (5) schedule every 60–90 min — no need to book ahead; (6) for return, same window at Cozumel Ferry Terminal (Muelle Punta Langosta) — same rates; (7) avoid the cheaper 'Barcos Caribe' option (community reports less-reliable schedule); (8) NEVER board 'private boats' from Playa's public beach — licensed only.
scams.avoidance: Buy at official Ultramar or Winjet window — MX$680–$820 round-trip Credit card or cash at window; get printed QR ticket No 'VIP', no 'express', no upgrade tier exists IGNORE every WhatsApp and hotel-concierge ferry offer NEVER board 'private boats' from Playa public beach
scams.location: Playa del Carmen ferry terminal (Muelle Fiscal), Ultramar + Winjet windows, ferry-approach touts, WhatsApp 'discount ferry' resellers

scams.name: Playa del Carmen Colectivo Van & Tulum-Transit Overcharge
scams.description: The colectivo (shared van) network between Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Akumal, and Cancún is Mexico's most-affordable tourist transit — but touts exploit foreign travellers unfamiliar with local systems. r/cancun 'Whats the best and cheapest way to get to Tulum from' (comments/jc206x) is the community baseline. r/cancun 'Getting to tulum from Margaritaville? Uber/taxi too expensive' (comments/199rgfr) documents the pricing pressure. r/cancun 'Corrupt police and airport scam vent' (comments/1begpy2, 2024) covers the broader tout environment. Legitimate fares: Playa-to-Tulum colectivo MX$60–$80 per person (60 min); Playa-to-Akumal MX$40–$60 (30 min); Playa-to-Cancún MX$60–$80 (60 min). ADO bus Playa-to-Tulum MX$140 (same duration, air-conditioned, assigned seats). Uber Playa-to-Tulum MX$600–$900 (if available). Colectivo stops on Calle 2 (southbound to Tulum) and at ADO terminal. The 2025 scams: (a) Calle 2 corner touts quoting 'Tulum colectivo MX$250 per person' (real MX$60–$80); (b) 'VIP private van Tulum transfer' at US$80 (real Uber US$30–$50 if available); (c) hotel concierge kickbacks directing to MX$2,000 'private driver' for a colectivo-equivalent trip; (d) fake 'ADO ticket' resellers outside ADO terminal at 2x face value; (e) 'colectivo to Chichén Itzá' offers — no direct colectivo exists (you must transit via Valladolid, 2 separate colectivos + detour); (f) driver demanding MX$100+ per bag 'luggage fee' inside colectivo (Rp 10–30 is fair or often included); (g) 'last colectivo of the day' urgency pressure claiming you must pay 3x. For older travellers: (1) for Tulum, use ADO bus from Playa's ADO terminal MX$140 — air-conditioned, assigned seats, printed ticket, safest/easiest; (2) for colectivo, go to Calle 2 × 15th-20th Avenue corner (southbound side) — state 'Tulum' and confirm MX$60–$80 BEFORE boarding; (3) no legitimate 'VIP' or 'private' colectivo exists — it's shared by definition; (4) luggage: fair fee is MX$10–$30 per large bag, often included; (5) Chichén Itzá: take ADO bus from Playa (Rp 600–750) OR drive via CUOTA toll road — colectivo chain is exhausting; (6) NEVER buy ADO tickets from 'resellers' outside terminal — use official window only or ado.com.mx; (7) Uber Playa-to-Tulum MX$600–$900 if you want private + safer than street taxi; (8) r/cancun 'Whats the best and cheapest way to get to Tulum' (comments/jc206x) details 2024-25 community recommendations.
scams.avoidance: Use ADO bus for Tulum MX$140 from Playa's ADO terminal Colectivo: Calle 2 × 15-20 Ave corner, state 'Tulum', confirm MX$60-80 Buy ADO tickets at official window or ado.com.mx — never resellers Chichén Itzá: ADO bus or CUOTA-road drive, not colectivo chain Uber Playa-Tulum MX$600–$900 for private alternative
scams.location: Calle 2 colectivo stop, ADO bus terminal, highway-approach taxi queues, hotel-lobby 'private transfer' desks, Tulum/Akumal/Chichén Itzá transit corridor

scams.name: Playa del Carmen ATM DCC Scam & Hotel USD Exchange Padding
scams.description: Playa del Carmen shares the Cancún-region ATM and exchange scam ecosystem with a 5th Avenue density twist. r/cancun 'Best way to exchange USD for Peso's?' (comments/1pr3h2m, 2025) is a 2025 regional named anchor. r/cancun 'Hotels not changing dollars for pesos?' (comments/1idd9cc, 2025) documents the hotel-rate-padding pattern. r/MexicoCity 'A tip for tourists: When using the ATM, do NOT accept' (comments/1e6hw8v, 2024) is the canonical DCC-fraud anchor. The 2025 scams: (a) 5th Avenue freestanding ATMs at 2–3 per block with 'Would you like your home currency conversion?' DCC prompts — if accepted, 8–15% worse than bank rate; (b) hotel-lobby ATMs (Cardtronics, EuroNet) with MX$100–$200 ATM fees PLUS DCC; (c) Playacar resort reception USD-to-pesos at MX$16 per US$1 when Bank of Mexico rate is MX$18.5 per US$1 (12–15% padded); (d) OXXO ATMs with transaction cancellation fraud where 'cash not dispensed' but account is debited (requires immediate bank dispute); (e) 'foreign card surcharge MX$250' added to some merchant transactions (illegitimate); (f) 'cash-back' at 5th Avenue pharmacies at terrible exchange rates. For older travellers: (1) use ONLY ATMs INSIDE bank branches — HSBC, Banamex, Santander, BBVA — located on Av. 10 Norte in Downtown Playa (not 5th Avenue); business hours 9 AM–4 PM Mon–Fri; (2) when the ATM asks 'home currency conversion?', ALWAYS select 'NO' or 'Continue in MX Pesos'; (3) set LOW daily limits (MX$3,000 max) + transaction alerts; (4) bring US$200–$400 cash emergency buffer; exchange SMALL amount at legitimate casa de cambio (NOT hotel) in Downtown Playa at MX$18.3–$18.7 per US$1; (5) for daily spending, prefer tap-to-pay credit card — interbank rate is usually 1–2% better than ATM; (6) dedicated travel debit card (not primary); (7) AVOID Playacar resort USD-to-pesos at MX$16 padded rate; (8) if ATM malfunctions mid-transaction, take photos of screen + receipt, contact bank IMMEDIATELY for dispute.
scams.avoidance: Bank-branch ATMs on Av. 10 Norte (HSBC, Banamex, Santander) only ALWAYS select 'NO / Continue in MX$' for DCC prompt Set MX$3,000 daily limit + transaction alerts Exchange at Downtown Playa casa de cambio, not Playacar hotels Prefer tap-to-pay credit card for daily spending
scams.location: 5th Avenue freestanding ATMs, hotel-lobby ATM booths, OXXO convenience-store ATMs, Playacar resort 'front desk' USD exchange

scams.name: Playa del Carmen Time-Share Booth & 'Free Excursion' Promoter Extortion
scams.description: Playa del Carmen's 5th Avenue has the highest density of 2025 timeshare promoter kiosks in Mexico — aggressive English-speaking reps offering 'free excursion vouchers', 'US$200 resort credit', or 'VIP nightclub passes' in exchange for attending a 'presentation'. r/cancun 'Got roped into a presentation at Iberostar Cancun' (comments/1okgj7v, 2025) documents the cross-region pattern. r/cancun 'Your best Here's how I got away from the timeshare' (comments/1aq6o4f, 2024) is the community defence-compilation. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) 5th Avenue sidewalk promoters with clipboards asking 'Are you on vacation? I have something for you' — 90 seconds of friendliness, then 'free breakfast + US$200 voucher for a 90-min presentation'; (b) Playacar resort welcome desks offering 'free snorkel tour for listening to our resort info'; (c) presentations actually run 3–5 hours with high-pressure sales tactics, US$30,000–$120,000 timeshare pitches; (d) multi-agent rotation with 'the manager' arriving when you decline; (e) credit-card 'hold' authorisation traps; (f) 'cancellation fee US$500' if you try to exit early; (g) cruise-day-trip targeting — promoters specifically hunt Cozumel/Cancún cruise passengers with '2-hour presentation + Tulum ruins day trip'. For older travellers: (1) WALK PAST every 5th Avenue sidewalk promoter — no 'free voucher' is worth 3–5 hours of high-pressure sales; (2) if engaged anyway, firm 'no gracias' and keep walking — don't stop or smile; (3) if you DO attend, set a HARD 90-minute timer and stand up to leave; NEVER authorise credit-card 'holds' during presentation; (4) Mexican law grants a 5-business-day cooling-off period — if you signed, file PROFECO complaint (profeco.gob.mx) + registered mail to property's legal department within the window; (5) for cruise-day visitors: r/cancun 'Thanks everyone for all tips' (comments/1kshczq, 2025) notes pier-side 5th Ave promoters specifically target short-visit tourists; (6) the 'free excursion' vouchers often turn out to be for commission-shopping tours, not actual excursions; (7) if you want real Tulum ruins day trip, book independently via GetYourGuide (US$50–$80) not via timeshare promoter; (8) if pressured to stay in presentation, say 'Necesito hablar con mi abogado' (I need to speak with my lawyer) — professional closers respect this.
scams.avoidance: WALK PAST every 5th Avenue sidewalk promoter — no engagement If engaged, firm 'no gracias' and keep walking; don't stop If attending, 90-min timer; walk out regardless of sales tactics NEVER authorise credit-card 'holds' during any presentation Mexican 5-day cooling-off: file at profeco.gob.mx if you signed
scams.location: 5th Avenue sidewalk promoters, Playacar gated-resort welcome desks, Parque Fundadores tourist-info booths, cruise-passenger day-trip targeting

scams.name: Playa del Carmen Corrupt Police Document-Check & Rental-Car Checkpoint Shakedown
scams.description: Playa del Carmen is in Quintana Roo state — which has Mexico's most-documented 2025 corrupt-police-tourist extortion pattern. r/cancun 'Police scam' (comments/1kkl08i, 2025) is a canonical 2025 anchor. r/cancun 'Cancun police corruption' (comments/1r2w6h6, 2025) documents the broader Quintana Roo pattern. r/cancun 'Corrupt Police Alert!!!!' (comments/1bzb432, 2023) is the baseline. The 2025 shakedown patterns: (a) Highway 307 rental-car checkpoints (Playa-Tulum, Playa-Puerto Aventuras) with officers finding 'infractions' — MX$2,000–$10,000 demanded cash to 'avoid problems'; (b) 5th Avenue nightlife stops after 11 PM demanding passport check and 'drug sniff' — MX$500–$5,000; (c) scooter/motorcycle riders stopped on Av. 15 demanding 'licence check' then extracting MX$1,500–$3,000; (d) 'helpful officer' at beach offering to 'escort your group home' with tip MX$500+; (e) overnight holding-cell threat if cash refused (usually bluff); (f) fake officers in plain clothes with visible 'badge' running same template. For older travellers: (1) if stopped by police, IMMEDIATELY ask to see BADGE with name + officer number and WRITE IT DOWN in phone notes; (2) firmly state 'quiero hablar con el consulado' (I want to speak with the consulate) + '911 por favour' — fake officers abandon at phone mention; (3) NEVER surrender your original passport — show a laminated photocopy carried specifically for this; (4) NEVER pay cash on the spot — insist any fine be WRITTEN and PAID AT THE DELEGACIÓN (police station); (5) NEVER unlock your phone for any officer; (6) RECORD audio on phone if shakedown proceeds (Mexican law allows one-party consent); (7) save numbers: US Embassy +52 55 8526 2561, Consulate Playa del Carmen +52 984 873 0303, Quintana Roo State Police (English) +52 984 802 4045; (8) if shakedown occurs, file denuncia at Fiscalía General Quintana Roo within 48 hours; (9) for rental-car drivers specifically, keep all documents in original + copies in glove box for quick presentation; (10) drive CONSERVATIVELY on Highway 307 — no speeding, all signals used, all documents current.
scams.avoidance: Ask for BADGE + officer number; write down immediately Say 'quiero hablar con el consulado' + '911 por favour' NEVER surrender passport; show laminated photocopy only NEVER pay cash on spot — insist on written fine at delegación US Embassy +52 55 8526 2561; Consulate Playa +52 984 873 0303
scams.location: Highway 307 rental-car checkpoints, 5th Avenue nightlife after 11 PM, Playa beaches at night, Downtown scooter riders stopped on Av. 15
